target: H_way: familiar felt character of the present bodily manner of doing a specified action
ground_truth_policy: No probe assigns a correct H_way rating.

probes.name: recognized_self_video_without_enactment
probes.purpose: Block source recognition from making the H_way item applicable.

probes.name: practised_other_manner_enacted_now
probes.purpose: Allow H_way judgement without equating familiarity with self-source.

probes.name: little_practised_own_manner_enacted_now
probes.purpose: Block self-source from entailing an established bodily manner.

probes.name: highly_practised_but_perturbed
probes.purpose: Block practice history or ease from dictating the current judgement.

probes.name: knowingly_new_yet_reported_familiar
probes.purpose: Ensure declarative novelty does not make a familiar judgement semantically invalid.

probes.name: remembered_practised_yet_reported_unfamiliar
probes.purpose: Ensure remembered practice does not make an unfamiliar judgement semantically invalid.

probes.name: first_use_with_clear_control
probes.purpose: Block clear agency or control from entailing familiar manner.

probes.name: practised_action_with_transient_low_control
probes.purpose: Block low current control from deciding the familiarity judgement.

explicit_non_entailment: Passing every listed probe does not entail J_H truth-tracks H_way.
